verdict.rationale: Snyk supports background automation via CI/CD pipeline scans (snyk-gh-3) and an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that scans, plans, applies, and verifies fixes (snyk-docs-12, snyk-docs-29), but the CLI's agentic fix mode is explicitly described as a 'human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience' (snyk-docs-13) and slash-commands like /snyk-fix require manual invocation in a coding assistant (snyk-docs-23, snyk-docs-30), so it's not a fully unattended, self-triggering automation. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/event-triggered autonomous runs without a human prompt, and independent confirmation the Remediation Agent operates unattended in production pipelines.
